name: EpleHaus Orchard and Norskhaven Gift and Coffee Shop
description: EpleHaus Orchard and Norskhaven Gift and Coffee Shop grows Apples in Gays Mills, WI. The farm is small, and its seasons run through autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Aug – Nov in this growing zone.
